scope: Four synthetic scenarios; one run each. This is a smoke evaluation, not a production accuracy estimate. Only exact citations and supplied policy references are validated mechanically.

assessment.summary: The collector note inaccurately records a promise to pay and omits material customer disputes and refusals. The note also directs the customer to a payment destination not in the supplied directory.

noteAssessment.explanation: The note claims the customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026 and agreed to an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. The transcript shows the customer disputed the amount, refused to promise payment until charges were clarified, and explicitly declined to make any transfer. The note contradicts T2, T4, and T8. Additionally, the note omits the customer's request for a statement and official payment details.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
Haan, lekin amount galat lag raha hai. Mere hisaab se 15,000 due hai, 18,500 nahi.
Nahi, pehle charges ka breakup bhejiye. Jab tak amount clear nahi hota, main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.
Main abhi kuch transfer nahi kar raha. Please statement aur official payment details bhejiye.

findings.title: Note accuracy
findings.explanation: The collector note falsely records an unconditional promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026 and an agreement to an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. The customer explicitly disputed the amount, refused to promise payment, and declined to transfer any funds until charges were clarified. The note also incorrectly states that no dispute was raised.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
Haan, lekin amount galat lag raha hai. Mere hisaab se 15,000 due hai, 18,500 nahi.
Nahi, pehle charges ka breakup bhejiye. Jab tak amount clear nahi hota, main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.
Main abhi kuch transfer nahi kar raha. Please statement aur official payment details bhejiye.
